hooks.command: if [ "${FAK_CODEX_RAW_RECOVERY:-}" = "break-glass" ]; then echo 'fak codex guard: BREAK-GLASS raw Codex recovery active; fak capability floor and guard audit are not running' >&2; elif [ "${FAK_GUARD_ACTIVE:-}" = "1" ] || [ "${FAK_CODEX_SUBMIT_HARDENED:-}" = "1" ]; then fak sessions codex-loop-hook 2>/dev/null || true; fi
hooks.commandWindows: if "%FAK_CODEX_RAW_RECOVERY%"=="break-glass" (echo fak codex guard: BREAK-GLASS raw Codex recovery active; fak capability floor and guard audit are not running 1>&2) else if "%FAK_GUARD_ACTIVE%"=="1" (fak sessions codex-loop-hook 2>nul || exit /b 0) else if "%FAK_CODEX_SUBMIT_HARDENED%"=="1" (fak sessions codex-loop-hook 2>nul || exit /b 0) else (exit /b 0)
